title.narrative: Supporting small scale farmers in North Macedonia

description.narrative: The core support modality at this phase supports the organisationsl efforts in: i) improvement of socio-economic conditions in rural areas, ii) rural development through the sustainable business for young farmers and women, iii) inclusion of all minority and socially vulnerable groups in the value chain, iv) decrease the rural poverty, improve the agriculture organization, and expand the agriculture markets. Specific areas of interest within the frame of the 2025-2028 partnership are: i) organizational development, regional networking and education, ii) lobby and improved market linkages, and iv) increased gender equality and support of vulnerable groups in rural area.
